bullets.text: A motorist died in Uthukottai when a roadside banner fell on his two-wheeler, and the office should monitor road safety enforcement.
The meteorological center warns of heavy rain in Chennai and Thiruvallur, so the office should coordinate disaster preparedness measures.
A mosque and madrasa demolition near Thiruvallur sparked local tension, and the office should watch community reactions closely.
Stormwater drain work in Puzhuthivakkam is delayed because railway authorities have not granted permission for a year, and the office should intervene with railways.
A DMK councillor at the Adyar zonal meeting expressed frustration that officials ignore local grievances while acting on press reports, and the office should address these coordination gaps.
An elderly man died after being hit by a metropolitan bus at Ponneri old bus stand, and the office should review local transport safety.
Tribal residents staged a protest in Thiruttani demanding housing site pattas, and the office should direct the tehsildar to examine their claims.
Villagers petitioned Collector Kavitha over pollution caused by a private rice mill in Nerkundram, and the district team should inspect the unit.
Tamil Nadu launched a pilot platform to simplify film shooting permissions online, and the portfolio team should track the rollout.
DVAC arrested publisher R. Mohan over a procurement fraud involving AI-generated books in public libraries, and the office should review digital content verification protocols.
The Madras High Court directed the DGP to submit district-wise missing persons data including AI tool usage details, and the portfolio team should monitor compliance.
A TVK IT wing official's video alleging cash transactions for party seats caused a stir in Kanyakumari, and the office should note the political fallout.
AIADMK leader Jayakumar criticized the government over district administration issues, and the office should prepare a factual response.
